technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and price above all key MAs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dips than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: F shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 27 days with elevated risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, mixed seniority
sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from three sales (85-101 days old) combined with neutral market sentiment and absent news data provides no actionable conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (301.12) with imminent NFP event and earnings in 27 days creates hostile trading environment despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX, price above MAs, supertrend bullish, OBV rising) with support at 17.86 provides technical foundation for continuation traders on dips.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across all oscillators (RSI 9/14, Stoch, Williams %R, MFI), VIX crisis regime, imminent earnings in 27 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for immediate entry.
